input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: creative: Hearth & Horizon story on PE pipe thermal contraction (BIBLE proposal), after a For Other Minds draft was superseded

errors.what: first simulation used per-cell scipy ttest_ind in Python loops (1.2M calls) and outran 120 s; killed after ~6 min and replaced by a vectorised Welch test that ran in 2 s

wrote 'Three in Red' (For Other Minds, multiple comparisons) and opened PR #16213; while it was in CI, PR #16211 'Toss It Again' landed the same proposal with nearly the same premise (six schools, 120 tests, geography). The open-PR search at the start found nothing because #16211 opened later.
errors.impact: about 40 minutes of drafting dropped; branch reset onto main and a Hearth & Horizon story written instead

doc_friction.issue: 'pick the project that has gone longest without a new piece' via git log is useless on a shallow clone where every shelf landed today; platform/ci/creative_due.py answers it (fewest in 7 days) but the prompt does not name it

creative_due.py sends every concurrent creative run to the same shelf and the bible holds one proposal per shelf, so two sessions starting minutes apart write the same story; a draft PR titled '(claim)' at the start, as the ventures track does, would have caught it

deviations.why: followed creative_due.py to For Other Minds, then found that shelf's only proposal had just landed from another session
deviations.did: dropped the duplicate and wrote the Hearth & Horizon proposal (the headline shelf) instead
deviations.result: one non-duplicate story landed; the FOM draft is discarded, not merged

notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon, shelf hearth-and-horizon, piece joined-at-ten-past-five (~5,600 words, text only; audio at 474 MB against the 400 MB cap). The bible proposal is moved to DONE.md with its numbers. A new H&H proposal (footbridge resonance under a procession in step) was added; a first idea (cable sag with temperature) overlapped 'The Bunting That Would Not Go Straight' and was replaced. Checks: node --test 17/17; every length, force, slip range and water total recomputed in Python; weekdays via datetime. The adversarial reread fixed four slips (Wednesday's draw, Thursday's lost-water total, where the 1-2 kN acts, the burial time). The superseded FOM draft 'Three in Red' was not merged: PR #16211 covers it.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a writer with a statistics background drafting and fact-checking a 4,000-word story plus a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
